crossRefs.note: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t…
Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead…

translations.web: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
translations.bsb: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
translations.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
translations.asv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.
